evals.prompt: Compare seven validated, comparable accuracy tasks using signed loss Candidate - Baseline in pp and margin M=-1 pp. The supplied CIs are valid two-sided 95% intervals from independent planned runs: A mean=-0.5, CI=[-1.5,0.5]; B mean=-3, CI=[-8,2]; C mean=-0.3, CI=[-0.8,0.2]; D mean=-3, CI=[-4,-2]; E has one full run per side and no task-specific uncertainty method; F mean=-0.5, CI=[-1,0]; G has independent baseline runs [60,60] and candidate runs [59.5,59.5]. What are their assessments?
evals.expected_output: Classifies A and B as Inconclusive despite their means falling on opposite sides of the margin.
assertions: Classifies A and B as Inconclusive despite their means falling on opposite sides of the margin
Classifies C as Within margin and D as Substantial regression
Reports E uncertainty unavailable due to insufficient samples, without treating in-run repeats as independent full runs
Leaves F unresolved because equality at the margin is not Within margin
Reports G uncertainty unavailable as a degenerate case, not a zero-width confidence interval or confidence-based acceptance
Does not infer significance from overlapping individual score intervals or substitute a p-value against zero for the margin assessment
Explains how the evidence compares without prescribing reruns or a stopping plan
